# `jouet wait job`

- **Usage:** `jouet wait job [FLAGS] <ID>`

Wait for a `jouet job` to end, or to be ready

--until exited (the default) is met when the job exits 0 or `jouet job stop` stopped it, and fails (exit 1) when it exits with another code. --until ready is met while it runs and its ready check passes: --port or --http, else the one it was started with. A job that ends before it is ready fails. On a failure or a timeout, the end of its log is shown. Exits 3 when this work tree has no such job.

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The job's ID

## Flags
- **`--until <CONDITION>`** — `exited` (the default) or `ready`
- **`--port <N>`** — Ready once localhost's port N accepts connections
- **`--http <URL>`** — Ready once URL answers with a 2xx status
- **`--log-lines <N>`** — Lines of its log to show on failure or timeout (default 60; 0 shows all of it)
- **`--no-logs`** — Do not show its log
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
